about: Master plan and work queue for Claude threads, built from items Cal approved in docs/product-backlog.md. Threads may change only status, passes, pr and notes. Cal adds, removes or reorders tasks. Status values: todo, in_progress, done, blocked.

plan.how_to_pick: Take the lowest 'order' task whose status is todo, whose depends_on tasks are all done, and whose lane is not used by any running thread (including UI threads). One task per thread.

lanes.tooling: scripts/, package.json devDependencies, CI-adjacent test tooling
lanes.editor: apps/web/app/reports/[id]/page.tsx, components/ObservationEditor.tsx, SignaturePad.tsx, lib/localDraft.ts, lib/serverStore.ts saveDraft, app/engineer.css

plan.ui_work: Cal's standing priority: the UI must be clear, easy to use, professional and inviting. UI tasks from the 'UI clarity and polish' thread are added here with their own lane mapping; a UI task that edits editor or office files uses that lane.
plan.audit: Statuses and notes below come from a read-only audit of main at 13e96a0 on 2026-10-20 (AUDIT-1). No browser checks have ever been run for these tasks; Playwright is not installed.

tasks.title: Audit task statuses against the code
tasks.description: Some approved items may already be partly or fully built (corrections, PM acknowledgement and draft recovery work landed 7-14 Sept). Check each task below against the code, tests and docs/optimisation-progress.md.
acceptance: Every other task's notes say what already exists, with file paths
Tasks that are fully built and tested are proposed as done in the PR description, not set to done without evidence
No application code changes in this PR
tasks.notes: Done read-only on 2026-10-20; results are in each task's notes.

tasks.title: Make browser checks runnable in cloud threads
tasks.description: Acceptance steps need browser checks, but Playwright is not installed, so scripts/verify-*.mjs cannot run. Add Playwright as a dev dependency using the preinstalled Chromium, and document the command in CLAUDE.md.
acceptance: npm ci installs Playwright without downloading browsers (PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD)
At least one scripts/verify-*.mjs runs green in a cloud thread after npm test && npm run build
CLAUDE.md names the exact command
tasks.notes: Done 2026-10-20: playwright 1.56.1 pinned as a root dev dependency (its Chromium revision 1194 is the one in /opt/pw-browsers). npm ci downloads no browsers, with or without PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD. verify-role-access and verify-engineer-layout pass; engineer-layout was updated for UI changes since September. verify-pdf-navigation fails on a real app fault: pdfjs-dist 6.3 calls Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed, which Chromium 141 lacks, so the PDF viewer shows an error in older browsers. Not fixed here (outside this task).

tasks.title: Show the in-app PDF on older browsers
tasks.description: The in-app PDF viewer shows 'getOrInsertComputed is not a function' instead of the report on Chromium 141, and likely on older iPhones, because pdfjs-dist 6.3's modern build uses Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed. Found by the TOOL-1 thread.
acceptance: The viewer renders a report PDF on the preinstalled Chromium 141 with no error shown
scripts/verify-pdf-navigation.mjs passes after npm test && npm run build, and fails if the viewer shows an error
tasks.notes: 2026-10-20: apps/web/app/reports/[id]/pdf/page.tsx loads pdfjs-dist/legacy/build (page and worker), which polyfills newer browser features. verify-pdf-navigation now fails on any on-screen viewer error and matches the report URL by pathname. Not verified on a physical iPhone or in WebKit.

tasks.title: Explicit PM acknowledgement
tasks.description: PM acknowledgement with actor, timestamp and optional note, kept separate from server receipt, delivery, approval and issue closure. Sending never waits for acknowledgement.
acceptance: Acknowledgement records actor and timestamp, optional note
It is stored and shown separately from receipt, delivery, approval and closure
Tests for the acknowledgement record
tasks.notes: Built: serverStore.ts acknowledgeReport, route, office dialog (ProjectsView 'Read' row beside Received, Review, PDF and notification). 2026-10-20: tests/corrections.test.ts now asserts actor, id, timestamp and trimmed optional note are stored; receipt time, review, delivery and the raised issue are untouched; approval and issue closure do not set it; status.ts keeps each fact's own words. No application code changed.

tasks.title: Preserve signatures across reloads
tasks.description: A signature captured in a draft survives a reload.
acceptance: Sign, reload, signature still shown and saved to the server
Test covering signature persistence
tasks.notes: Done 2026-10-20 in PR #6: the name and drawing save with the draft as draftSignature (server and device copy) and become signature on sending. Tests: apps/web/tests/signatures.test.ts. Browser check: scripts/verify-signature-reload.mjs (light and dark). Not checked on a physical phone.

tasks.title: Hide the review queue when review is disabled
tasks.description: Review remains off by default; its queue is hidden when off.
acceptance: With review off, no review queue or count appears in the PM view
Test or browser check for both settings
tasks.notes: 2026-10-20: lib/reviewQueue.ts reviewInUse decides per project (review required, or a submitted report still pending). With it off the office hides the Inbox To review and Returned filters, the Issues Not reviewed filter and count, and the register's review wording. Checked by tests/reviewQueue.test.ts and scripts/verify-review-queue.mjs (in use, then off). Report rows still tag a report that is itself pending or returned, and the report reader keeps its Review row.

tasks.title: Surface unfinished reports on the home screen
tasks.description: Unfinished drafts appear on the engineer home screen.
acceptance: Home screen lists unfinished reports with project and last-saved time
Browser check
tasks.notes: 2026-10-20: the engineer home has an Unfinished reports list of every draft the engineer started, on every project open to them, newest change first, each with project, card count and last save (lib/unfinishedReports.ts). A copy on this device the server has not acknowledged shows Not yet on the server; a device copy the server cannot be asked about shows Only on this phone; a copy of a report the server says was sent is left out. Checked by tests/unfinishedReports.test.ts and scripts/verify-unfinished-reports.mjs.

tasks.title: Show pending uploads and server acknowledgement
tasks.description: Make pending uploads and server acknowledgement clear.
acceptance: The engineer can tell which text and photos are saved on the server and which are pending
Browser check with the server stopped and restarted
tasks.notes: Done 2026-10-20: each card row and each photograph in the report editor says On the server, Uploading, Not yet on the server or Only on this phone (lib/uploadStatus.ts), and the Check & send step sums up what is still to go up. While the server cannot be reached the editor retries every 15 seconds, so a stopped server catches up by itself. Tests: tests/uploadStatus.test.ts. Browser check: scripts/verify-photo-uploads.mjs (server stopped and restarted, 390px light and 1440px dark). Not checked on a physical phone.

tasks.title: Action-focused PM view
tasks.description: Surface new reports, unacknowledged reports, unassigned issues and verification.
acceptance: PM view shows each of the four groups with counts
Browser check of the office view
tasks.notes: 2026-10-20: the office position shows four groups with counts: New reports (received on the previous working day or since, London time; Monday counts Friday), Not yet read, Unassigned issues and Ready to verify, with Acknowledge, Assign and Verify on each row. lib/officeActions.ts holds the rules; each group opens its filtered list (#/inbox/show/new, #/inbox/show/notAck, #/issues/show/unassigned, #/issues/show/verify; the Inbox gained a New filter). Checked by tests/officeActions.test.ts and scripts/verify-office-actions.mjs. Bank holidays are not known.

tasks.title: Explain and resolve conflicting versions
tasks.description: Explain and resolve conflicting versions without silently losing work, including two tabs editing one draft.
acceptance: A conflicting save shows both versions and lets the user choose or merge
Neither version is lost silently
Tests for stale-save conflict and two-tab editing
tasks.notes: A refused draft save returns the server copy (409 + current); the editor shows both versions card by card, suggests choices from the base when known, and saves the chosen or merged version on the server version. Per-tab save journal; work set aside per tab during a conflict; tabs announce saves. Tests: tests/draftConflict.test.ts. Browser: scripts/verify-draft-conflict.mjs.

tasks.title: Collapse updates into a summary
tasks.description: Collapse completed updates into a description, location and photo-count summary.
acceptance: A completed update shows as one line with description, location and photo count
The update can be expanded and edited again
Browser check of the engineer report screen on a phone-width viewport
tasks.notes: Done 2026-10-20 with UI direction item 2: below 900px every card folds to a summary row (kind, location, one-line description, photo count, and why it would stop sending); tapping a row opens that card under it, tapping again or Done with this card folds it. Wide screens keep the rail. scripts/verify-report-editor.mjs checks it at 390px and 1440px in light and dark.

tasks.title: Show descriptions and thumbnails when linking an issue
tasks.description: Show descriptions and/or thumbnails when linking an existing issue.
acceptance: The link-issue picker shows each issue's description and a thumbnail where one exists
Browser check
tasks.notes: Mostly built: defect/access picker shows description and thumbnail (ObservationEditor.tsx:85-111). Variation link is a plain select without thumbnail.

tasks.title: Distinct submission stages
tasks.description: Show acceptance, PDF preparation, delivery and PM acknowledgement as distinct stages.
acceptance: Each stage shows separately with its own state
Local outbox files are never shown as delivered email
Browser check
tasks.notes: Done 2026-10-20: lib/status.ts submissionStages gives a sent report its own steps (Received, Review only where review is used, PDF, Delivery, Read), shown by components/SubmissionStages.tsx in the office reader and on the engineer's report page. The worker records which step a failure belongs to (deliveryErrorStage). Delivery is stated from what happened: a local outbox file is 'Not emailed'; 'Emailed to ...' needs the mail transport to have sent it; SharePoint projects show filing. Tests in tests/submissionStages.test.ts; browser check scripts/verify-submission-stages.mjs.

tasks.title: Add another update at the same location
tasks.description: Add another update at the same location without copying findings or evidence.
acceptance: An action on an update starts a new update with the location filled in
Findings, photos and other evidence are not copied
Test covering the new update's fields
tasks.notes: Not started: addCard() always starts a blank observation (app/reports/[id]/page.tsx:257).

tasks.title: Undo removing an update or photograph
tasks.description: Offer undo when removing an update or photograph.

Undo restores it, including its photos, without a duplicate save
Test for remove then undo
tasks.notes: Not started: removing a card or photo is immediate (ObservationEditor.tsx:126,138).

tasks.title: Suggest responsible companies and locations
tasks.description: Suggest responsible companies. Location suggestions are optional, derived from prior entries, and need no setup or exact naming (EXP-4 rules out a location catalogue).

Free text is always accepted; nothing requires a maintained list or exact match
Test for the suggestion source
tasks.notes: Partial: location chips from prior entries exist (app/api/locations/route.ts, ObservationEditor.tsx:90-99). Engineer 'Who needs to respond' has no company suggestions; neither source is tested.

tasks.title: Search and filter the issue register

acceptance: Filters for location text, responsible company and verification status
Results cover the whole authorised register with pagination
Tests for the query, including SharePoint-backed paging with the fixture adapter
tasks.notes: Not started: GET /api/issues returns everything and filters client-side; no location text search or server paging. Also touches office/IssuesView.tsx.

tasks.title: Traceable corrections and revisions
tasks.description: Corrections create traceable revisions rather than overwriting sent reports, and resulting issue changes keep their report provenance.
acceptance: A correction creates a new revision; the sent snapshot is unchanged
Issue changes from a correction record which revision made them
Tests for revision and provenance
tasks.notes: Mostly built: correctReport creates a new revision; snapshot unchanged. Issue provenance is note text only (IssueEvent has no reportId/revision); no test that the sent snapshot is unchanged.

tasks.title: Living site diary
tasks.description: A chronological project timeline assembled from existing reports and observations, with no second round of data entry, preserving report provenance and revision history.
acceptance: Timeline built only from existing report data
Each entry links to its report and revision
Tests for timeline assembly; browser check
tasks.notes: Not started. Depends on structured issue provenance from FE-6b.

tasks.title: Extend offline capture
tasks.description: Extend offline capability deliberately beyond retained-text recovery, toward cold-start offline capture.
acceptance: Scope of the extension agreed with Cal before building
Behaviour verified on physical iOS and Android devices
tasks.notes: Needs Cal to agree the scope and to test on physical phones.

tasks.title: Additional report types

acceptance: Cal names the first report type and its fields, signatures and rules
That type works end to end without assuming the progress-report workflow

tasks.title: Search reports, issues and variations
tasks.description: One search page for every role: find a report, issue or variation by any word remembered (location, reference, company, name, note), across the projects open to the person, without opening each project.

Office desk unchanged (office lane). Loads every record per search, fine for the pilot's volume; revisit with SQLite FTS if it grows.

tasks.title: Printable snag lists
tasks.description: A snag list for one project: the open issues a company or trade has to put right, grouped by location, to hand over on paper or as a PDF, or walk the site with on a phone. Opened from the office Issues register and the engineer Issues view.
acceptance: Lists only open issues on the chosen project, narrowed by company or person and by trade, grouped by free-text location with no location catalogue
Each item shows reference, description, what to do, owner, target date, a past-target or fixed tag and optionally the photograph taken when it was raised
Prints black on white without the app chrome, keeping the prototype banner
Tests for the list rules; browser check at 390px light and 1440px dark, including print
tasks.notes: lib/snagList.ts, app/issues/snag-list (page and snag.css), a Snag list link in office IssuesView and the engineer Issues view. Read-only: ticking on paper records nothing; work is still submitted as complete on each issue. Checked by tests/snagList.test.ts and scripts/verify-snag-list.mjs. Not verified: a physical printer or phone, SharePoint mode.
